rules.book: Native recorder ts_et in America/New_York; bid_1/ask_1 only. Snapshot last_trade is never used.
rules.clock: Filed W1_GROUND_TRUTH_TABLE formation_end_game and bell_epoch, not trace first-stage recorder-open time. Explicit verified span_end also recorded; no synthetic data to bell.
rules.first_tick: Exact instant both sides have a true trade since formation; first=minimal causal state with both traded, not simultaneous-minute trades.
rules.missing: No snapshot/anchor substitution for missing true prints; no first postformation trade excludes the pair.
rules.role_open: Filed leg*_open_postformation_c, kept separately from first pool-observation prices.
rules.second_close: Group by floor(exchange_ts)/floor(book ts); within each stream use original source row order (custody files have no SQLite rowid), closing last/book; true-print min/max and size sum use all accepted prints in the second; stamp at greatest contributing native ts; no synthetic formation row
rules.true_trade: true_print=true; exchange_ts, price_cents, size; identical trade_id rows deduplicated, conflicting identities fail; ties keep source order.
rules.volume: Sum of true-print size since formation; exact trade count counts unique trade_id, not changed prices or minutes.

organ_contract.first_bind: observed pair receipt prefix; flips increment only on an observed directional reversal
organ_contract.prediction_grid: subsequent fixed atlas gates only; independent of query future ticks
organ_contract.q: query current last + weighted quantile(member remaining minimum - member current last)
organ_contract.remaining_path: gate carried state plus native historical member changes through bell; earliest tied minimum
organ_contract.x: independent weighted median(member remaining floor minutes-to-bell); query bell - X*60
